scope: Same-agent repair and clean-extraction validation limited to the three reported P2 findings. This is not independent peer review, proof-assistant certification, hardware validation, or a guarantee of venue acceptance.
preserved_theory_scope: conditional exact-state and atomic single-ownership assumptions

timing_data_repair.automatic_sync: paper/build.py recomputes the six medians from the retained CSV, verifies the corresponding summary.json values, writes paper/scaling-data.tex, and requires the generated macros in both the abstract and Section 6.6.
timing_data_repair.comparability_limit: The retained values describe single-worker Python checking cost within that historical run only; cross-machine comparison and physical migration performance are unsupported.

independent_validator_repair.validation_order: list type and length, then exact integer type and range for every element, then duplicate and sorted-order checks
independent_validator_repair.least_valid_positive: one-event certificate accepted by production and independent validators
independent_validator_repair.no_least_valid_positive: two-event witness accepted by production and independent validators
independent_validator_repair.result: Both validators reject every malformed payload without an uncaught exception; valid certificates still pass.

post_repair_reproduction.chunking_note: The complete n=4 exact domain was split into 40 nonoverlapping single-P-index chunks; the scientific domain and inclusion rules were unchanged.

final_archive_verification.status: completed after this record was frozen and before delivery
